title: A Girl

Hey there, lookin' at me, just lightin' me, just a sight of you inside of me, and then

me dry from me, I said, hey girl, ooh, why you trippin' on me, why aren't you free for
you, to make the same mistakes, to make me better than you think, teach me instead of

run away from me, cause I got the power to feed your selfish seed, your narcissistic ways, don't
stand a chance with me?
